description: Auditable NoSmi recovery choices for the 400-row USPTO Revisit example set. Exact aliases preserve identity; active_component entries intentionally omit a carrier solvent or heterogeneous support and must not be interpreted as the full material formulation.

overrides.name: palladium on carbon
overrides.note: Use [Pd] as the catalytically active component; carbon support and loading are not molecularly defined.

overrides.name: palladium on charcoal
overrides.note: Use [Pd] as the active component and omit the heterogeneous carbon support.

overrides.name: 10% palladium on carbon
overrides.note: The percentage describes catalyst loading, not a molecular structure.

overrides.name: palladium hydroxide on carbon
overrides.note: Use Pd(OH)2 and omit the heterogeneous carbon support.

overrides.name: Raney nickel
overrides.note: Use [Ni] as the active component; the porous alloy catalyst has no unique molecular SMILES.

overrides.name: Oxone
overrides.note: Use the active peroxymonosulfate salt rather than assigning a false single structure to the commercial triple salt.

overrides.name: hydrogen chloride in dioxane
overrides.note: Carrier solvent and concentration are omitted; the active reagent is HCl.

overrides.name: hydrogen chloride in 1,4-dioxane
overrides.note: Carrier solvent and concentration are omitted; the active reagent is HCl.

overrides.name: hydrochloric acid in dioxane
overrides.note: Carrier solvent and concentration are omitted; the active reagent is HCl.

overrides.name: 4.0 M hydrochloric acid in 1,4-dioxane
overrides.note: Concentration and carrier solvent are metadata, not molecular identity.

overrides.name: 4M hydrochloric acid in dioxane
overrides.note: Concentration and carrier solvent are metadata, not molecular identity.

overrides.name: 4N hydrochloric acid in dioxane
overrides.note: Concentration and carrier solvent are metadata, not molecular identity.

overrides.name: ethereal hydrochloric acid
overrides.note: Diethyl ether is a carrier solvent; the active reagent is HCl.

overrides.name: hydrogen chloride in diethyl ether
overrides.note: Diethyl ether is a carrier solvent; the active reagent is HCl.

overrides.name: ethanolic hydrochloric acid
overrides.note: Ethanol is a carrier solvent; the active reagent is HCl.

overrides.name: lithium aluminum hydride in tetrahydrofuran
overrides.note: THF is a carrier solvent; the active reagent is LiAlH4.

overrides.name: 10% sodium hydroxide in D2O
overrides.note: D2O and concentration are omitted from the active reagent structure.

overrides.name: sodium alendronate aqueous solution
overrides.note: The verified sodium alendronate trihydrate record represents the solute; bulk aqueous solvent and concentration are omitted.

overrides.name: N,N-dimethylaminopyridine
overrides.note: The paragraph uses the conventional acylation catalyst DMAP.

overrides.name: 6-chloro-2-pentanone
overrides.note: Carbon 6 is impossible for a pentanone; the product's 3-chloropropyl substituent confirms 5-chloropentan-2-one.

overrides.name: malonic acid monoester potassium salt
overrides.note: The same paragraph forms ethyl 3-(4-pyridyl)-3-oxopropionate, identifying the monoester as ethyl.

overrides.name: N,N-dimethyl-2-(4-methyl-1H-indol-3-yl)methanamine
overrides.note: The paragraph explicitly names dimethyl-(4-methyl-1H-indol-3-ylmethyl)-amine.

overrides.name: 2-methyl-2-oxiranylmethyl (S)-4-nitrobenzenesulfonate
overrides.note: The patent identifies this reagent as (S)-2-methylglycidyl 4-nitrobenzenesulfonate.

overrides.name: BOP
overrides.note: BOP is interpreted as the peptide-coupling reagent only in the synthetic reaction context.

overrides.name: CEE HCl
overrides.note: The paragraph title and preparation identify CEE HCl as creatine ethyl ester hydrochloride.

overrides.name: free base of 4-isopropylphenylacetimidate
overrides.note: Ethanol is the alcohol used in the Pinner reaction in the same paragraph.

overrides.name: E2 free base
overrides.note: The free-base identity is given by the product title before fumarate salt formation.

overrides.name: pyridine nitrile A466.2
overrides.note: Ethylmagnesium bromide conversion to A466.3, 1-(6-bromopyridin-2-yl)propylamine, identifies the nitrile.

overrides.name: lithiated veratrole
overrides.note: The paragraph product is 4-(2,3-dimethoxybenzoyl)pyridine, fixing the lithiation site.

overrides.name: 7α-(5-bromopentyl)-11β-fluor-estra-1,3,5(10)-triene-3,17-diol
overrides.note: The product title and steroid convention specify the 17beta alcohol omitted by the model.

overrides.name: p-n-decyloxybenzoic acid p'-(2-methylbutoxycarbonyl)phenyl ester
overrides.note: The same paragraph gives both ester partners and the 2-methylbutyl alcohol residue.

overrides.name: 4-chloro-pyrimidin-2-yl)-(3,4,5-trimethoxy-phenyl)-amine
overrides.note: The extracted name is missing its opening parenthesis and N locant.

overrides.name: 2-benzyloxy-4-chloro-N-tert-butoxycarbanilide
overrides.note: The exact product name is given in the paragraph title.

overrides.name: diphenylphosphoryl azide
overrides.note: Use the diphenyl phosphate ester (DPPA), not diphenylphosphinic azide.

overrides.name: diethyl malonate
overrides.note: Use the neutral diethyl ester of malonic acid.
